headline: G2 GOLDFIELDS DRILLS INTO THE DEEP: 84.5m @ 3.0 g/t Au Extends OKO Gold Resource to 1km Vertical
snippet: G2 Goldfields' deepest hole to date at the OKO project in Guyana returned 84.5m at 3.0 g/t gold from 915m depth — including 6m at 13.4 g/t — extending high-grade mineralization a further 140m vertically to 1km, still open, weeks before G Mining Ventures is set to close its acquisition of the company in June.

headline: RECORD COPPER GRADES: Power Metallic Hits 17.45m @ 9.47% CuEq at Lion Zone, Q3 Resource Estimate Ahead
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSX-V: PNPN) released winter drill assays from the Lion Zone at its Nisk project — 17.45m at 9.47% CuEq (including 6.3m at 17.91%) and a separate 39m hit at 5.66% CuEq — as the company builds toward a Q3 2026 mineral resource estimate across a 200m infill strike.

headline: GOLD SLIPS TO $4,564, SILVER PLUNGES 3%: Trump's 'Project Freedom' Drains Strait of Hormuz Risk Premium
snippet: Precious metals sold off sharply on May 4 after President Trump announced 'Project Freedom,' a U.S. naval escort operation through the Strait of Hormuz that markets read as geopolitical de-escalation. Gold retreated to $4,564/oz while silver dropped 3.1% to $72.82 — though both remain up 37% and 124% year-over-year respectively.

headline: USA RARE EARTH +72% IN APRIL: $2.8B Serra Verde Deal Secures Brazilian Critical Magnet Supply
snippet: USA Rare Earth surged 71.6% in April after announcing a definitive $2.8B agreement to acquire Brazil's Serra Verde Group — the only mine producing all four critical magnetic rare earth elements — cementing the company's role in the U.S. domestic supply chain as Trump's 'Project Vault' targets a $12B critical minerals reserve.

headline: AFRICA'S EXPLORATION RACE: Which Junior Miners Are Pulling Ahead on the World's Most Under-Drilled Frontier?
snippet: As major producers consolidate and retail capital returns to speculative plays, a May 4 analysis examines which junior explorers are gaining ground across West, Central, and East Africa — the continent's junior sector described as 'the true lifeblood' of future resource supply as under-exploration persists.

headline: NEWMONT ON THE HOT SEAT: What the Gold Giant's Latest Move Should Have Told Investors All Along
snippet: Motley Fool's May 2 deep-dive argues that Newmont's most recent disclosure was telegraphed well in advance — and breaks down what the world's largest gold miner's latest move signals for investors benchmarking the senior mining complex heading into a record-margin environment.

headline: URANIUM NEAR 2-MONTH HIGH AT $86/lb: The Quiet Nuclear Rush Powering AI Data Centers
snippet: Uranium spot held above $86.50/lb this week — its highest in two months — as Meta secured agreements for 7.8 GW of nuclear capacity and Microsoft locked in reactor supply for 800 MW of AI datacenter load. With Kazatomprom signaling higher prices are needed to raise output, the supply-demand setup is tightening faster than most retail investors realize.

headline: SPODUMENE CROSSES $1,000/t: ASX Lithium Miners Are Plotting Expansions After 18 Months in the Desert
snippet: Spodumene prices have broken through US$1,000 per tonne for the first time since late 2023, prompting Pilbara Minerals to restart its mothballed Ngungaju plant and Core Lithium to begin ore extraction at Finniss this month — with UBS and JP Morgan both raising their 2026 spodumene forecasts above US$1,800/t.

headline: COT REPORT MAY 1: Speculators Hold Near-Record Gold Longs — Bullish Fuel or Crowded Trade Warning?
snippet: GoldSeek's May 1 Commitment of Traders breakdown for gold, silver, and the U.S. dollar index shows speculative net longs in precious metals remain heavily stacked — a positioning signal that historically precedes either continuation rallies or sharp corrective shakeouts as overcrowded trades get flushed.

headline: CHINA FRONT-LOADS 790+ TONNES OF SILVER: The Structural Demand Floor Smart Money Isn't Ignoring
snippet: GoldSeek's Gold SWOT highlights China's import of over 790 tonnes of silver in early 2026, driven heavily by solar panel manufacturing — a structural industrial demand floor that underpins silver prices even as geopolitical safe-haven flows reverse, and that J.P. Morgan cites in its $81/oz average 2026 silver forecast.

headline: COMMODITY BULL CASE: Gold, Copper, Silver Rally Ahead — Why Barrick, Newmont, and Power Metallic Belong in Every Portfolio
snippet: A Stockhouse contributor makes the bull case for a broad precious and base metals rally, arguing that record margins, compressed multiples, and institutional underweighting set up Barrick and Newmont as core positions — with junior play Power Metallic Mines as the high-upside complement for retail investors willing to take exploration risk.
